cases.title: Events and Alerts - Alert Viewer - Filter List
cases.section_path: Cloudfare / Events and Alerts / Alerts Configuration / Alert Viewer
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** the user is signed into Cloudfare
**AND** the Events & Alerts claim is accessible to the current user
**AND** the Alert Viewer page is displayed under Events & Alerts > Alerts 
**AND** the selected Operating Company is at the level of above that for an Operating Company to have active Alerts
**AND** an Actions multi-select drop down menu is available to filter the data on the page. Default value: Uncleared
**AND** a Severity multi-select drop down menu is available to filter the data on the page. Default value: Any
**AND** a Device Type multi-select drop down menu is available to filter the data on the page. Default value: Any
**AND** an Ownership Category multi-select drop down menu is available to filter the data on the page
**AND** the option to commit the selected filters is available
**AND** a Recent Activity table is displayed with the most recent activities performed on Alerts as per the filters
**AND** the option to View Details for an Alert related to the activity is available
**AND** an Alert List is displayed containing a list of triggered Alerts as per the filters provided in reverse chronological order
**AND** Alerts have a severity indicator

- Critical - red triangle with !
- High - red circle with !
- Medium - yellow circle with !
- Low -  blue circle with !
- Information - blue circle with "i" 

**AND** an interactive status indicator will be displayed for each rule depending on whether it has been Acknowledged/Cleared
**AND** the table is searchable
**AND** selecting an Alert from the list

cases.title: Topology & Fares Management - Import Map Point File - xml - Out of scope
cases.custom_steps:
The system shall allow for a new station/rail line to be added.

*Note: 
A stop is added when it’s ID, as defined in the map point file is not already present in
CloudFare.
A stop is updated when its ID is already present in the system, and the stop details
provided in the map point file differ to the stop details already present in CloudFare.
The details provided in the map point file take precedence.*

cases.title: Topology & Fares Management - Products - Configure Barcode Products
cases.custom_steps:
As an Administrator I want to configure when a Barcode should be printed on an individual Paper Ticket, so the barcode can be used to allow passenger travel on these tickets.

Constraints:

- The Flowbird device will use this information to append a barcode onto the end of the ticket. Flowbird consider this to be the optimum location for presentation of the barcode to a validation device. By appending the barcode to the end of the ticket it also allows the position of the barcode to be automatically adjusted for tickets that have variable length fields that can span one or many lines on the ticket.
- If an individual ticket is being produced for multiple passengers the device will not encode a barcode on the ticket
- The space between the end of the ticket and the barcode will be determined by Translink via the use of a single example in their ticket template document
- Flowbird will replicate this distance across all other ticket types. To allow Translink to calculate the space required, Flowbird will provide Translink with the size of a barcode module (single black square). However, as an indication of how this might look, an example is given below:

cases.custom_steps:
Introductory remark: the following user story shall be applied for the following tables (Settings module - feature System Settings):

Device Registration

Merit Integration Service

Estate Management

Topology

Automatic imports

Station Manager

Given I have access to the Settings module.

When I go to CF-> Settings module - feature System Settings.

When the toggle button is in the « Disabled » (“Désactivé” in French) state and it is clicked, the toggle button shall switch to the « Enabled » (“Activé” in French) state.

When the toggle button is in the « Disabled » state and it is clicked, the value in the "Value" column shall change to « Enabled ».

When the toggle button is in the « Enabled » state and it is clicked, the toggle button shall switch to the « Disabled » state.

When the toggle button is in the « Enabled » state and it is clicked, the value in the "Value" column shall change to « Disabled ».

cases.title: AFCBOS-3991: CLONE - CloudFare - Topology & Fares - Publishing Label Configuration returns error saying label has been published when it has not been
cases.custom_steps:
When a label is created for a configuration, and then it is published, sometimes when attempting to publish the label it comes up with an error saying label has been published already when it has not been. When a new label is made again for the same configuration (e.g. add a 1 to end of name), then the publish of the label works. 

Steps to Reproduce:

Sign into CloudFare
Navigate to Topology & Fares page
Select the three dot menu by the page title
Select Label Configuration 
Enter a name for the label
Select Apply
Select the three dot menu by the page title
Select Publish Configuration
Select the Label 
Select Publish
Expected Result:

Labelled configuration should be published

Actual Result:

Says label has been published already and then you have to create a new label and try again until it works

cases.title: AFCBOS-4872 - Quarantine Filters not populating
cases.custom_steps:
Expected: When clicking on a filter dropdown from quarantine it populates with the relevant data (i.e. Device Ids for the Device Id dropdown, Message Types for the Message Types drop down, etc.)

Actual: When clicking on a filter dropdown from quarantine they do not populate with any information and error (in the console) after 100s

 

At the Translink level of the hierarchy (and some sub-operators too) when clicking on the drop down for one of the quarantine filters it will not populate with the contents (i.e. Transaction/Shift/Journey/etc. for the Message Type field).

The request seems to timeout after ~100s and produce the following error:



We have just upgraded CloudFare in live from V141.4 to V148. The only noticeable change I've seen in the release notes is AFCBOS-4113 which was to only show relevant devices in the device ID filter.

When I compare the sub-operators that have working filters with those that do not have working filters it is apparent that the number of devices under an operator level is influencing whether or not the filters will load

cases.title: AFCBOS-4874 - CLONE - CloudFare v148 - Area selection - Product Assignment
cases.custom_steps:
There seems to have been a regression issue introduced from something (maybe the introduction of product type group functionality for Commutitre?) that is resulting in the area filter for product assignment also showing assignments at higher levels of the hierarchy.

Note that I was not able to see anything on the release note for the addition of this Product Type Group functionality.

Steps to reproduce:

From the screenshot below you will see that in CloudFare I set the hierarchy for Translink to NIR, clicked product assignment, chose the EUROCrossBorder area and pressed Show Products for Area and Type Group.

Expected Result: The list of product assignments is updated to only show those applied at the EUROCrossBorder area

Actual Result: The list of product assignments contains those at the EUROCrossBorder area in addition to some at the NIR operator level.

NOTE: This is having an impact on the live system as Translink are now no longer able to add an assignment at an area level if an assignment already exists at the Operator level.

NOTE 2: This also seems to be having an impact on the database as it seems changes to product assignments are not setting the previous version to inactive, thus resulting in old assignments staying in the database

This occurs for all areas so I suspect is reproducible anywhere and is not Translink data related.

![](index.php?/attachments/get/180411)


 

Note also, that clicking on "Translink" at the top of the page I believe previously showed all of the assignments at the Translink level but now the NIR level is still shown.
![](index.php?/attachments/get/180412)



 

Given the regression nature of this bug we would expect this to either be booked to project in which this was introduced (maybe Commutitre?) or to a product budget.

cases.title: AFCBOS-5147 - Topology Publish Configuration Timing Out
cases.custom_steps:
Changes made to support https://jira.flowbird.group/browse/AFCBOS-4944 has caused the publishing of configuration to timeout when publishing large datasets. Issue was identified attempting to publish Perth (SRUP) Topology.

The Snapshot Manager previously contained functionality that extracted MapPoints along with their associated Fares and Zones passing a Rest Client Timeout value which extended the default timeout. Unfortunately this has been replaced with a method that requests all MapPoints associated with provided operator identifiers, but this does not contain a timeout override and doesn't even utilize the supplied operator identifiers as there is no endpoint in the Topology BS that accepts the provided query parameters, and therefore defaults to GetAll.

cases.title: AFCBOS-5066 - Route which can be reassigned to the new operator can be reassigned with service
cases.custom_steps:
We have a few conditions when route can't be reassigned. Scenario name are showing details and can be used in test purpose:

Scenario: Route can not be moved up in the hierarchy if map points are assigned to child operator
Scenario: Route cannot be reassigned up when a current operator has a non-inherited product group assigned to it
Scenario: Route cannot be reassigned up when a current operator has a fare area assigned to it
Steps:

Navigate to Topology > Route Management
- Try to assign a service that has a route with map points assigned to a child operator to the parent operator.
- Try to assign a service that has a route with non-inherited product to the parent operator.
- Try to assign a service that has a route with fare area assigned to the parent operator.

Expected: service is not assigned, conflict error about it route displaying. 

Actual: service assigned. See attachments for route reassigned and service reassigned with non-inherited product

Apparently, when we reassign service which is own that route - reassigning is successful but the data like fare area, map points, product is lost.

 

Few scenarios prepared for that restrictions. They can be used to seed data and check code changes:

Scenario: Service cannot be reassigned up when a current operator has a non-inherited product group assigned to it route

cases.title: AFCBOS-4381 - Consistent warning/error across the CloudFare sites that warn a user when Operators aren't configured
cases.custom_steps:
When operators aren't populated and Cloudfare returns 403 pages, It's usually not clear what the issue is when configuring CloudFare for the first time or troubleshooting the CloudFare environments. Unless doing so many times, receiving a 403 page when operators aren't populated in the system can be a bit vague.

Is there a possibility to have a consistent message that prompts the user to add the operators else there can be time wasted troubleshooting other areas.

Scope: All sites. (Except System Config) 

Proposed Solution

The error page should not show "Access Denied". It should state "No Operators have been configured for this system yet. Please set up the Operators needed for this system.".

Where red banner error messages show currently, they should be changed to show a more meaningful error like the proposal above.

![](index.php?/attachments/get/187073)

cases.title: AFCBOS-5143 - Statements values are always saved regardless of if the 'Cancel' or 'Save' button is pressed
cases.custom_steps:
When editing statements for a rule Toplogy > Fares > Rules > Add Function then the values updates/added are always saved regardless of whether the 'Cancel' or 'Save' buttons are pressed. 

 

Steps to reproduce: 

Go to Toplogy > Fares > Rules > Add Function for a rule

Change any of the field values

Click on cancel

Exit and then go back to the same screen

 

Expected result:

The new/updates field values were not saved

 

Actual result:

The new/updates field values were saved

____________________________________________________________________________________
Triaged: 
Changed to improvement PBI as the above is apparently how the system was originally designed!
There are two options: 

1) Add the Save/Cancel functionality to the 'statements' fields. 
2) Remove the Save/Cancel functionality and buttons so that any changes to name or statements fields will be autosaved. 

Option 1 is a large piece of work requiring some system re-design. 
Option 2 is a small piece of work with an estimate of 1SP. 

Option 2 will be chosen.

cases.title: AFCBOS-5083 - CLONE - CloudFare - CF Dashboard Counts Temporarily Incorrect
cases.custom_steps:
When the status of a device changes (in this case it is an AVM going from degraded to full service), the CF dashboard temporarily reports the wrong device count. In the screenshot you can see that the dashboard is showing the degraded count as 2 whereas the number of degraded devices at the time is actually 3. Linked to this, the dashboard is taking too long to refresh the device statuses/counts.
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187077)

In addition, when the dashboard tile is filtered to only show AVMs, whenever a machine changes state, it will report every device registered in CF until the user refreshes the page.
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187078)

Steps to reproduce:

Bring up the TVM Status Table and filter to only show Add Value Machine devices with operating company PTA
Ensure the device you are working on shows up in the all column of the dashboard
Send a device status message from the device either via postman if using a simulated device or by inducing a change of operational state on a physical device
Monitor the behaviour of the dashboard as soon as this device status message is sent
Things to look out for include the dashboard counts not matching up (first screenshot) or dashboard counts suddenly displaying every device connected to CF (second screenshot)
 

Expected Results:

The TVM Status Table (dashboard) always correctly reflects the current operating status of the AVMs connected to CF

Actual Results:

The TVM Status Table (dashboard) sometimes displays all devices connected to CF when a change in operational state of a device has recently taken place

The TVM Status Table (dashboard) counts are incorrect when a change in operational state of a device has recently taken place

cases.title: AFCBOS-5405 - CLONE - Transaction Data does not match data from legacy devices in SmarTrack
cases.custom_steps:
EDIT160623: Outstanding issue:

int1_class_attribute and int1_ctrl_seq_no should be set to 0 on Autoload top-up

Standard PV: Autoload Top-Up
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187506)

Standard Legacy PV: Autoload Top-Up
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187507)

Same results observed when tested repeated on current versions

CloudFare Version 157

Integration Version  cf-tpsmartrackint-bs:999.0.43.2

Platform Validator 127.6

Full table attached here: PV Autoload top-up Comparison.xlsx

The data populated in the transaction data table in SmarTrack does not match the data imported from the legacy devices.  This will cause issues with the reports that are run on this data.

Initial indications is that some of these discrepancies are caused by the information sent from the device, and some by CF not populating the data correctly.

For tag on and tag off records the following has been noticed:

Tagon

int2_Class – Not being populated (is 0)
int1_card_seq_no – Not being populated (is NULL)

int1_boarding_type - If a transfer journey is being set to the journey count on the card, not 1 (device)

int2_service_trip_no  -- is 0, legacy device is NULL (rail devices only)
int4_fleet_id – is -1, legacy is NULL (rail devices only)

Default tag on reader BV - int2_boarding_location – is recording the current stop (7), not the first stop in the route as the boarding stop
int4_landmark_number / str_stop_name – is recording the current stop, not the first stop in the route as the boarding stop (device)

 

tag off:

int2_Class – Not being populated (is 0)
int1_class_attribute – not being populated (is NULL)
int1_zonal_indicator – was 1, legacy was 0  (need to check around this a bit more)
int1_card_seq_no – Not being populated (is NULL)

int2_service_trip_no  -- is 0, legacy device is NULL (rail device only)

int4_fleet_id – is -1, legacy is NULL (rail device only)

 

Other transaction types (top-up, Card control etc) have not been checked yet

 

further checks:

 

In addition to the differences above, some other fields are different in a transaction where autoload is applied. This doesn't occur on other value addition transactions (eg BPay)
See spreadsheet - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lPAfjjmS9AjW1lT-uiYaEyYvVcXrrG8-4qkaqxfmDaA/edit#gid=0

int1_class_attribute - legacy devices show 0, new devices show NULL
int4_pta_form_no - as above
int1_ctrl_function - as above
int1_ctrl_seq_no - as above
INt2_agent_identifier - legacy shows 9999, new devices show NULL

cases.title: AFCBOS-5439 - CLONE - [CloudFare] CloudFare web pages stop auto updating if they have been in the background
cases.custom_steps:
If a Web browser tab that is showing a CloudFare page which auto updated (e.g. Dashboard, commms monitor table etc) has been in the background for a period of time (a few minutes) it will stop auto updating, and stay displaying stale data when the returns to the browser tab.

e.g. A bus depot staff member may want to monitor a dashboard tile, the comms monitor table and events an alerts throughout the day and they set these up as different tabs and alternate between them, when a tab stops auto updating they may be looking at out of date data without realising it.

 

The disconnection period appears to vary slightly between sites, dashboard 3 minutes, estate manager (comms monitor) 1 min:
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187508)
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187509)
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187510)
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187511)
Steps to Reproduce:

Use a web browser to view a CloudFare page which auto updates
On the Same browser window open a new tab and leave that tab in focus for a period of time (e.g. 5 minutes)
view the original tab with the CloudFare page
Expected Result:

The page is shown and the content auto updates (or at the very least indicates to the user that the page needs to be manually refreshed)

 

Actual Result

The page is displayed but remains showing the data information at the time of disconnection.

cases.title: AFCBOS-5595 - Re-CLONE - Area selection - Product Assignment
cases.custom_steps:
There seems to have been a regression issue introduced from something (maybe the introduction of product type group functionality for Commutitre?) that is resulting in the area filter for product assignment also showing assignments at higher levels of the hierarchy.

Note that I was not able to see anything on the release note for the addition of this Product Type Group functionality.

Steps to reproduce:

From the screenshot below you will see that in CloudFare I set the hierarchy for Translink to NIR, clicked product assignment, chose the EUROCrossBorder area and pressed Show Products for Area and Type Group.

Expected Result: The list of product assignments is updated to only show those applied at the EUROCrossBorder area

Actual Result: The list of product assignments contains those at the EUROCrossBorder area in addition to some at the NIR operator level.

NOTE: This is having an impact on the live system as Translink are now no longer able to add an assignment at an area level if an assignment already exists at the Operator level.

This occurs for all areas so I suspect is reproducible anywhere and is not Translink data related.
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187523)

Note also, that clicking on "Translink" at the top of the page I believe previously showed all of the assignments at the Translink level but now the NIR level is still shown.
![](index.php?/attachments/get/187524)
Given the regression nature of this bug we would expect this to either be booked to project in which this was introduced (maybe Commutitre?) or to a product budget.

cases.title: CM2-5314 - TMS: Provides devices information
cases.custom_steps:
Actions:

Modify the database structure in order to store the deviceType when deploying a version (table: DEVICE_HISTORY)
Add a new endPoint to return the list of devices by type
Data will be returned based on information stored in the DEVICE_HISTORY table
Migration note:

You will need to perform a new deployment for the interface to work. (assuming that the DEVICE_HISTORY table is correctly populated)
TDD:

Definition of the new interface GET /devices/v1/parameters?deviceType=DEPOT
See the TDD
Analysis:
The method for applying a version to devices is poorly managed. It is the front which determines the implicit and explicit list of devices assigned to the deployment of a version.
As a result, only the device identifier is transmitted to the back-end in order to process the request.

cases.title: AFCBOS-5886 - CLONE - Translink TFTS - Translink - Quarantine Filling up with 'Error Duplicate Transactions' [INC0263553]
cases.custom_steps:
After speaking with the project we have have seen again 292 Transactions end up in quarantine with the error "Error duplicate transaction" full message of one can be found below, these have happened since migrating to SaaS and last time this happened was during the golive of SaaS but it was decided that these would be deleted in Quarantine. But Ideally we need to know why this has started happening as we've not seen this before even on the on-prem environment.

API error when requesting http://cf-transaction-bs-lb/: status code [Conflict], response [{"Message":"Error duplicate transaction","Data":{},"InnerException":null,"HelpLink":null,"Source":"Parkeon.CloudFare.BusinessServices.Transaction.Logic","HResult":-2146233088,"StackTrace":" at Parkeon.CloudFare.BusinessServices.Transaction.Logic.TransactionManager.CheckDuplicate(TransactionItem transaction, TransactionItem duplicateTransaction) in F:\\Build\\CloudFare\\bs-transaction\\master\\workspace\\TransactionBusinessLogic
TransactionManager.cs:line 152\n at Parkeon.CloudFare.BusinessServices.Transaction.Logic.TransactionManager.Save(TransactionItem transaction, Int64 deviceId) in F:\\Build\\CloudFare\\bs-transaction\\master\\workspace\\TransactionBusinessLogic
TransactionManager.cs:line 71\n at Parkeon.CloudFare.BusinessServices.Transaction.REST.Controllers.TransactionController.Post(IncomingTransactionViewModel incomingRecord)"}

Mark R has confirmed that this error is caused by Postgres not knowing how to handle time zones correctly and would require a bug being raised.

------------------------------

Relevant Information for this ticket:
Expected
Time zones being able to be handled and transactions being processed correctly and not ending up in quarantine.

Actual
Transactions ending up in Quarantine because Postgres does not seem to know how to handle the time zones.

Evidence
Body Content above and 220923 - Quarantine Transactions - Error duplicate transactions.PNG

Actual Result:

Device failed to update after deploying a new topology

cases.title: TODEV-9637 - Stage coach -Full Screen CloudFare Dashboard
cases.custom_steps:
FOR STAGECOACH VENDOR TRIAL / RFP2 TENDER RESPONSE

As a Customer Service / Operations Manager I want the option to display CF Dashboards in full screen mode so that the CF side and bottom menus are not displayed.

Scope of work
-Display a Full Screen button which when selected:
i. displays the selected dashboard
ii. removes the side menu
iii. removes the bottom menu
iv. maintains the display of the CloudFare logo

-Display an Exit Full Screen button which when selected:
i. Restores the side menu, bottom menu and logo to the standard position.

Constraints

-The change should maintain compliance with the current minimum resolution for a good mobile responsive experience @1280 x 800
-Full screen mode applies only to the Dashboard module

-The Full Screen button is displayed even if the user does not have any Dashboards configured.
-A dashboard can be displayed in full screen mode even if it does not contain any tiles.
-Any user can view a dashboard in full screen mode, this does not require a specific claim.
-In full screen mode the URL bar is still visible so that the URL can be saved to a bookmark for users who do not wish to use the full screen button.
-If the user is not logged in and launches the application from the full screen URL in their Favourites, they will need to login before being automatically directed to the dashboard.

Acceptance Criteria

Given I have permissions to view the Dashboard module
When I select the "Enter full screen" button
Then the Dashboard page is displayed in full screen mode
And the side menu is not visible
And the bottom menu is not visible or selectable

Given I am viewing the Dashboard in full screen mode
When I select the button to minimis the screen
Then the default Dashboard view is restored

cases.title: TODEV-11247 - Device Events API to allow Client Shift Id
cases.custom_steps:
As a device I want to be able to send a Client Shift Id to CloudFare with a Device Event

In summary, Translink are looking to extend the Tickets by Operator report in MERIT to include totals for new transaction counts including barcode validations, smartcard inspections/validations and ticket issues. To achieve this, we need to be able to send the relevant data to MERIT and this requires the Client Shift Id to be populated in the Device Events that go from devices to CloudFare. Currently the API for device events does not allow the Client Shift Id to be sent and so this must be amended to allow this. The field should be optional.

The internal database ShiftId associated with the ClientShiftId must then be persisted in the Alerts database.

cases.title: TODEV-8743 - Lack of informations regarding duplications of rules
cases.custom_steps:
Currently it is possible to have two rules with the same name under the condition that one of this rule comes from a parent-operator, and the other comes the operator itself (or another parent maybe).

Visually it is possible and easy to distinguish them, since the name of the operator from origin is displayed if it’s a parent-operator. 


However, the distinction is can not be done when we see the rules in the “Product affectation” submodule.
There we see the two rules with the same name without knowing which one come from where.

Expected Behavior
In order to avoid confusion for the user two options are possible : 
1) Preventing two rules from having the same name in the whole system regardless of the operator (can generate trouble if two distincts operators use the same name : the second one will see its rule refused)
2) Add a way to distinguish the rules according to their operator origin in the subdomule Product Affectation (and anywhere else it’d be necessary).

Reproduce scenario
Enter a topological version of an operator which has been created from another one using rules from its parent operator.

Create a rule with the same name as one of the rules existing in the parent operator (and available in the current operator).

See if the two rules are distinguishable everywhere

cases.title: TODEV-1872 - Perth- [Production] CloudFare needs to manage background status lists
cases.custom_steps:
Some CloudFare websites have Background Status lists showing the details of the state of any background job that has been run.  E.g. Schedule Management and Topology & Fares.

The lists are currently not managed and the website is loading all history when opened.

In Perth this has led to the Schedule Management website having extremely poor performance as the background task list had over 100,000 entries after only a few months.  (each TRIS import will create 50+ entries each time).

CloudFare needs to mange this much better.  I wouldn’t expect every single task to be loaded every time the webpage is loaded. Pagination functionality should be used instead. 

Decision by the team during triage is to implement a configurable limit (from System Configuration) with a default of 200, to limit the number of error entries shown in the background task list.

cases.title: TODEV-9616 - Stage coach -Apply a Percentage increase to base fares
cases.custom_steps:
As a user responsible for fare management I want to adjust the base fare for all fare triangles in a one-time single operation so that I don’t have to export, edit and re-import fare triangles.

Acceptance Criteria

Given that I want to apply a percentage change to all base fares in all fare triangles
And I have the appropriate claims to do so for the Operating Level at which I making the change
When I expand the Fare Assignment sub menu in F&T module
And select an "Adjust Base Fares" button
Then an "Adjust Base Fares" menu expands

Given the "Adjust Base Fares" menu is expanded
And I enter a % value
And I enter a positive value (5 for example) in a free text field labelled “%”
And a message is displayed "This operation will adjust all  base fares in all fare triangles immediately. Do you want to proceed?"
And I select "Accept/OK" (whatever is consistent with existing logic)
Then all base fares are INCREASED by the specified value
And the new fares are visible in all fare triangles.

Given I have triggered the percentage change to base fares
And the progress of the operation is displayed in the Background Status table.
When the operation is complete
And all base fares have been updated
Then the result should appear in the Background Status table.

Given that I have selected the option to "Adjust All Base Fares"
And I enter a negative value (-5 for example) in a free text box labelled "%"
And a message is displayed "This operation will adjust all base fares in all fare triangles immediately. Do you want to proceed?"
And I select "Accept/OK" (whatever is consistent with existing logic)
Then at completion of the process all base fares are DECREASED by the specified value.
And the new fares are visible in all fare triangles.

Given that I do not have a claim to this functionality
When I expand the Fare Assignment sub menu
Then the “Adjust All Base Fares” button is displayed but greyed out

Constraints

A claim to this feature should be configured in the User & Access Management Module UI
If applied at Translink level, NIR, UB and Metro inherit the increase.

If applied at UB level then all depots below inherit the change.

Increase is permissible between 1% and 100% - whole numbers only

Displays the result to 2 decimal points, no rounding is required

In this MVP version, there is no need to show how many fares were updated or not updated

This is a background task, the user can carry on using CF during the update

Exception handling is not specified here but some provision should be made to alert the user should the operation fail

cases.title: TODEV-16102 - Allow routes that belong to multiple depots to be sent to MERIT
cases.custom_steps:
Translink have an issue whereby they have some routes within their Metro operator that have the same (or similar) name to routes in their Ulsterbus operator. For their bus TVMs that have the ability to sell Metro tickets on an Ulsterbus TVM (or vice versa) they require both Metro and Ulsterbus routes to be sent to the same depots in MERIT (TU and TM).

This functionality was added last year but at the time it was not known that route numbers would be duplicated across the two operators. In order to remedy this the suggestion is for MERIT integration to be updated to allow the Metro routes to be given a prefix when being sent to either the TM or TU depot in MERIT (i.e. 10A would be sent as MET10A). Therefore the routes and route stages going into MERIT will need this prefix for these two depots

It is important to note that given that the route number would be different for these two depots, any transactions that are being sent to MERIT for those two depots will also need to have the prefix added to the routes in the transaction data.


______________________________________

 

AC

Given MERIT is receiving transactions / routes / route stages

When they have a ‘MET’ prefix in the transaction data

Then this indicates they are for the TM or TU depots



______________________________________


Notes
Currently Translink have routes in different operators but some of these are the same numbers. For example:

Metro:

Open image-20250212-150439.png
image-20250212-150439.png
Ulsterbus:

Open image-20250212-150547.png
image-20250212-150547.png
 

When data is published from CloudFare it also sends the published data to MERIT by company. So it first sends Metro routes (i.e. 12C, 13, 13A, 13B, 13C) and all associated stops within those routes and then sends Ulsterbus routes (i.e. 13, 130, 131, 131b, 132) and all associated stops within those routes. However, when MERIT is importing this data, the Metro routes are first processed fine but the Ulsterbus routes throw an error when it gets to a route that has the same number as Metro. This means that all of the associated stops on the Ulsterbus route do not make it into the MERIT database.

This causes issues with reporting as, when an Ulsterbus transaction is received for one of the duplicate routes (i.e. 13), the boarding and alighting stages in the transaction cannot be found in MERIT.

As such, if we adjust the functionality to make sure there are never duplicates (i.e. by adding a prefix) then we can be confident that all transaction data will be able to report on boarding/alighting stages correctly

cases.title: TODEV-15634 - CloudFare doesn't allow "to" time in time rules to include the minute selected
cases.custom_steps:
In CloudFare you can create time rules, which must have a start and end time,  However CloudFare does not allow the “to” time to include the minute selected (i.e. the time ends at hh:mm:00 and not hh:mm:59).

Example, In Perth there are days of free use so time rules are set up for 00:00 - 23:59 on the date range where  the customer is not to be charged, however the cusomters that tap between 25:59:01 and 23:59:59 get charged as this is not included.

When exporting the times to devices CloudFare sends this as seconds from midnight, so sends the above example as 0 to 86,340.  To be all day this should be to 86,399.

CloudFare should either allow seconds to be defined in the time rule to/from times, or if not assume the “to” time is hh:mm:59.

cases.title: TODEV-18347 - [Alerts] Prevent Empty and Duplicate Alert Names
cases.custom_steps:
User Story: Alert Configuration Validation
As an Operator, I want to be prevented from creating alerts with empty names or duplicate names within my operator account, So that I can ensure the clarity of alert configurations and easily manage them.

Business Value: This story ensures data quality and prevents confusion or errors in the alert system, making it more reliable and user-friendly for operators. It directly addresses issues that could lead to confusion as to the reason for alerts being raised.

Acceptance Criteria:

Scenario 1: Prevent creation of an alert with an empty name

Given I am on the "Alert Configuration" sub-module.

When I attempt to create a new alert.

And I leave the "Alert Name" field empty.

Then The system should display a clear validation error message indicating that the "Alert Name" is a mandatory field.

And The system should prevent the alert from being saved/created.

Scenario 2: Prevent creation of an alert with a duplicate name for the same operator

Given An alert named "Critical System Failure" already exists for my operator account.

When I am on the "Alert Configuration" sub-module.

And I attempt to create a new alert.

And I enter "Critical System Failure" in the "Alert Name" field.

Then The system should display a clear validation error message indicating that an alert with this name already exists for my operator.

And The system should prevent the alert from being saved/created.

Scenario 3: Successful creation of a valid alert

Given I am on the "Alert Configuration" sub-module.

When I attempt to create a new alert.

And I enter a unique and non-empty name in the "Alert Name" field.

Then The system should allow the alert to be successfully saved/created.

Additional Considerations (per Definition of Ready):

Details: The GUI for the "Alert Name" field should clearly indicate it is mandatory (e.g., with an asterisk). The validation messages should be user-friendly, informative and have translations for English and French.

Core Functionality: This is considered core functionality.

Dependencies: No external dependencies are identified as blocking this PBI. We need to anticipate and test the situation where a customer already has unnamed alerts or duplicate names when a new release containing this improvement is deployed. This includes defining a migration strategy or handling existing data gracefully.

cases.title: TODEV-15175 - Dashboard: Display Installation Point ID on Single-Device Tiles
cases.custom_steps:
AS A CMR Operations Team member, I WANT the Installation Point ID to be visible on all single-device dashboard tiles, SO THAT I can quickly identify a specific device and promptly contact ground staff to investigate potential faults.
The Customer is pushing to agree the criteria for achieving practical completion.  Part of this is that they are unable to use CloudFare for monitoring to the same level that they can with their existing tools, in particular for the rail devices (which includes AVM).

They generally like the content of the TVM Status Table but the one aspect which prevents them from using it is the meaningless location presented to them.

It was agreed to implement this by extending the existing “Location” column to:

Show the Location name instead of the current numeric internal ID. e.g. “Perth City” and not “70”.

If the equipment has an associated Installation Point ID, this will be appended to the Location name: e.g. “Perth City : ABC123GHJ”

Ensure there are spaces around the colon, so that the data content can word-wrap if necessary.

 

The Installation Point ID shall be clearly and uniformly displayed on all currently affected tiles (TVM Status Table, Hours Since Last Communication, and Recent Alerts) as well as on all future dashboard tiles that report on a single device. <<< The part in red needs to be a design consideration for any new tile that is added to the dashboard options but does not need to be included in the quote for the specific change.

The customer hasn’t specifically called out the Device with Status Count tile, but as this is another one where results can be drilled by individual device we should include it. The following pops-up when you click the tile and so the Location column will also need extending

Acceptance Criteria
General:
The changes apply to the following dashboard tiles: TVM Status Table, Hours Since Last Communication, Recent Alerts, and the pop-up/drill-down table associated with the Device with Status Count tile.

The term "Location" on these tiles refers to the specific column or field displaying location information for an individual device.

 

Scenario 1: Happy Path - Device with Location Name and Installation Point ID (TVM Status Table)

Given I am a CMR Operations Team member logged into the system

And I am viewing a dashboard containing the 'TVM Status Table' tile

And a specific TVM device listed has an associated Location Name (e.g., "Birmingham New Street")

And that same TVM device also has an associated Installation Point ID (e.g., "BHM987XYZ")

When I view the 'Location' column for that device's row in the TVM Status Table

Then the Location column should display the text "Birmingham New Street : BHM987XYZ"

And there must be a single space character on either side of the colon (":").

Scenario 2: Happy Path - Device with Location Name and Installation Point ID (Hours Since Last Communication)

Given I am a CMR Operations Team member logged into the system

cases.title: TODEV-18347: [Alerts] Prevent Empty and Duplicate Alert Names
cases.section_path: Cloudfare / Fixes/New Features / V220 Fixes (Released Features)
cases.custom_steps:
User Story: Alert Configuration Validation
As an Operator, I want to be prevented from creating alerts with empty names or duplicate names within my operator account, So that I can ensure the clarity of alert configurations and easily manage them.

Business Value: This story ensures data quality and prevents confusion or errors in the alert system, making it more reliable and user-friendly for operators. It directly addresses issues that could lead to confusion as to the reason for alerts being raised.

Acceptance Criteria:

Scenario 1: Prevent creation of an alert with an empty name

Given I am on the "Alert Configuration" sub-module.

When I attempt to create a new alert.

And I leave the "Alert Name" field empty.

Then The system should display a clear validation error message indicating that the "Alert Name" is a mandatory field.

And The system should prevent the alert from being saved/created.

Scenario 2: Prevent creation of an alert with a duplicate name for the same operator

Given An alert named "Critical System Failure" already exists for my operator account.

When I am on the "Alert Configuration" sub-module.

And I attempt to create a new alert.

And I enter "Critical System Failure" in the "Alert Name" field.

Then The system should display a clear validation error message indicating that an alert with this name already exists for my operator.

And The system should prevent the alert from being saved/created.

Scenario 3: Successful creation of a valid alert

Given I am on the "Alert Configuration" sub-module.

When I attempt to create a new alert.

And I enter a unique and non-empty name in the "Alert Name" field.

Then The system should allow the alert to be successfully saved/created.

Additional Considerations (per Definition of Ready):

Details: The GUI for the "Alert Name" field should clearly indicate it is mandatory (e.g., with an asterisk). The validation messages should be user-friendly, informative and have translations for English and French.

Core Functionality: This is considered core functionality.

Dependencies: No external dependencies are identified as blocking this PBI. We need to anticipate and test the situation where a customer already has unnamed alerts or duplicate names when a new release containing this improvement is deployed. This includes defining a migration strategy or handling existing data gracefully.

Steps to Reproduce

Actual Behavior

The tile updates to reflect the total count across all operators when configured with operators. In the example from the video the tile is showing counts :

AT Standard Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 17
AT Secondary Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 17
AT Master Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 17
AT Other Master Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 17

Counts should reflect the filtered operator counts

AT Standard Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 12
AT Secondary Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 2
AT Master Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 14
AT Other Master Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations  = 3

Environment


None
Description

When the dashboard is configured with missing transaction tiles filtered for individual operators, and new device transaction messages are sent with an out of order sequence id, the tiles update incorrectly. Instead of displaying the count for the specific operator, the tile updates to reflect the total count across all operators, which is the same value shown in the unfiltered tile.

This breaks the expected filtering behavior and causes confusion, as operator-specific tiles should only reflect data relevant to the configured operator.

 

STR



Background
    Given there is a dashboard in the system
    And following devices have registered and reported status:
    ^    Status         DeviceId    EquipmentType    HomeLocation
    >    FullService    1           Astreo           AT Location 1

    ^   TileNum    Operator                   MissingTransactions

    >   2          ${NONE}                    Cancellations
    >   4          AT Standard Company        ${NONE}
    >   5          AT Secondary Company       ${NONE}
    >   6          AT Master Company          ${NONE}
    >   7          AT Other Master Company    ${NONE}

    And following missing transaction have been sent:
    ^    Amount    OffsetDays       Device
    >    10        31               1  # Should not be included in the count after 30 days
    >    5         30               1
    >    2         1                2
    >    1         1                3
    >    1         1                4

    And following number of missing canceled transactions have been sent:
    ^    Amount    OffsetDays       Device
    >    1         31               1  # Should not be included in the count after 30 days
    >    3         30               1
    >    2         1                2
    >    1         1                3
    >    2         1                4
    When all transactions have been processed
    Then the missing transactions should have following data:
    ^   TileNum    Title                                                              Count
    >   1          Missing Transactions                                               9
    >   2          Missing Cancellations                                              8
    >   3          Missing Transactions and Cancellations                             17
    >   4          AT Standard Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations        12  #  Actual 17
    >   5          AT Secondary Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations       2   #  Actual 17
    >   6          AT Master Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations          14  #  Actual 17
    >   7          AT Other Master Company: Missing Transactions and Cancellations    3   #  Actual 17
 

The assertions from lines 43-46 are incorrectly displaying 17

The tile will update to reflect proper counts when doing a manual refresh.

cases.title: TODEV-18414: Date Filter Misinterprets Timezone Offset in DateTo Parameter
cases.section_path: Cloudfare / Fixes/New Features / V220 Fixes (Defects Resolved)
cases.custom_steps:
Priority


Medium
Components

Estate Mgt - WS
Affects versions

Cloudfare 208
Fix versions

Cloudfare 210
Steps to Reproduce

None
Actual Behavior

None
Expected Behavior

None
Environment


local

Description

When using the DateTo filter with a timestamp that includes a timezone offset (e.g., "2025-05-29T10:00:00.000+02:00"), the system appears to misinterpret the provided time as UTC, ignoring the specified offset. This results in incorrect filtering of records based on lastCommunicationDate.

Steps to Reproduce:

Have records in the database with the following lastCommunicationDate values (in UTC):

2025-05-29 09:00:00+00

2025-05-29 10:00:00+00

2025-05-29 11:00:00+00

Apply a filter with DateTo set to "2025-05-29T10:00:00.000+02:00" - by setting hours since last communication 3, 4 etc.

Expected Behavior:

The system should interpret "2025-05-29T10:00:00.000+02:00" as 2025-05-29 08:00:00 UTC and return records where lastCommunicationDate is earlier than this UTC time. Therefore, none of the records should be returned, as all have lastCommunicationDate values later than 08:00:00 UTC.

Actual Behavior:

The system returns records with lastCommunicationDate values of 2025-05-29 09:00:00+00 and 2025-05-29 10:00:00+00, indicating that it treats the DateTo value as 2025-05-29 10:00:00 UTC, ignoring the +02:00 offset.

cases.title: Operator can run a Retail Debt Report
cases.section_path: ABT / Operator Web Portal / Reports Management
cases.custom_steps:
https://jira.flowbird.group/browse/CA-11724

Debt Summary - remain the same

Debt Recovery Summary - Remove the following fields as they are not applicable:

Tap attempts
Customer online attempts
Operator online attempts

The Debt Report detail to contain the following columns:

Date/Time
Automatic debt retires
Remaining
Amount
Brand
Masked PAN
Transaction Reference
 

Technical design

The current debt report already collects retail transaction debts as well
The detail of wether the transaction type is retail or op is found in Transaction -> PaymentSchema column. When loading debts, the transaction table is linked as well through the AbtTransactionID column, therefore the information can be obtained for use inside the report as well.
Transaction table seems to be missing an index on (AbtTransactionID, OperatorID) which is used in queries, should be added.
Update Manager / Repository level implementation of debt report to accept 'Payment Schema' filter.

cases.title: Administrator can configure the End of the Operational Day
cases.section_path: ABT / Operator Web Portal / Administrator Settings Management
cases.custom_steps:
**NOT IN SCOPE**
**Given** An ABT Operator has signed into the Operator Portal
**When** the ABT Operator sets the End of the Operational Day
**Then** each operational day will be a 24 hour period
**And** each operational day will end at the time configured for End of the Operational Day
**And** each subsequent operational day will begin the minute after the time configured for End of the Operational Day

cases.title: Administrator can configure the End of the Operational Week
cases.section_path: ABT / Operator Web Portal / Administrator Settings Management

**NOT IN SCOPE**
**Given** An ABT Operator has signed into the Operator Portal
**And** the ABT Operator has set the End of the Operational Day
**When** the ABT Operator sets the End of the Operational Week
**Then** each operational week will be a 7 day period (start and end times based on configured End of the Operational Day)
**And** each operational week will end on the day configured for End of the Operational Week
**And** each subsequent operational week will begin the day after the day configured for End of the Operational Week

cases.title: Trigger a Pre-Authorisation check on first use each day - MasterCard
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer has not yet made a transaction today in this Transport Network using their MasterCard
**When** the customer uses their MasterCard payment card to make a transaction
**Then** a Pre-Authorisation check will be performed so that the card can be confirmed as valid by the issuer

cases.title: Trigger a Pre-Authorisation check on first use following removal from Deny List - MasterCard
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer has previously made transactions today in this Transport Network using their MasterCard
**And** this earlier transaction resulted in a Pre-Authorisation check being performed
**And** the customer's card is now on the Deny List 
**And** devices have been updated with the latest Deny List
**When** the customer attempts to use this blocked MasterCard payment card for further transactions
**And** this triggers a Tap Initiated Debt Recovery
**And** the card passes authorisation for payment
**And** the card is automatically removed from the deny list
**Then** a Pre-Authorisation check will be performed so that the card can be confirmed as valid by the issuer

cases.title: Trigger a Pre-Authorisation check on first use each day - Maestro
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer has not yet made a transaction today in this Transport Network using their Maestro payment card
**When** the customer uses their Maestro payment card to make a transaction
**Then** a Pre-Authorisation check will be performed so that the card can be confirmed as valid by the issuer

**And** this earlier transaction resulted in a Pre-Authorisation check being performed
**And** the customer's card is now on the Deny List 
**And** devices have been updated with the latest Deny List
**When** the customer attempts to use this blocked Maestro payment card for further transactions
**And** this triggers a Tap Initiated Debt Recovery
**And** the card passes authorisation for payment
**And** the card is automatically removed from the deny list
**Then** a Pre-Authorisation check will be performed so that the card can be confirmed as valid by the issuer

cases.title: ABT processes Taps received <= 14 days from date the date a customer tapped on the device
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer made a transaction tap on a device 
**And** Payment handling has already occurred (payment clears)
**And** the ABT Operator has configured the Maximum Late Data Period to 14 days
**When** the ABT system receives this tap <= 14 days from the customer's tap 
**Then** the ABT System will successfully process the tap
**And** the system will make any necessary adjustments to charges
**And** the customer will be charged the correct amount for their travel

cases.title: ABT rejects Taps received >14 days from date the date a customer tapped on the device
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer made a transaction tap on a device 
**And** the ABT Operator has configured the Maximum Late Data Period to 14 days
**When** the ABT system receives this tap > 14 days from the customer's tap 
**Then** the ABT System will reject the tap and not charge the card used for the journey


As Transport Operator I want to process taps received up to 14 days (configurable by a Flowbird Administrator) from the date the customer taps on a device, so that fares can be calculated. 



Note: Taps taken from both a Payment Card or Smartcard 



Constraint: 



	Late Date can be configured to a Maximum of 14 Days

cases.title: CA-12152 - Add encryption capabilities to settings store/retrieve and move implementation to common place
cases.custom_steps:
Currently we have an AES-256 algorithm implementation in Passenger Web Gateway. That needs to be moved in the Utils package, for common access.

There are some settings that are per tenant / operator, usually API / Access Keys (e.g. Identity Server client secret, that is per realm-client therefore per tenant, kleber request key or aws bucket access keys) that cannot be stored in the settings database in plaintext. Therefore they will first be encrypted (with a secret, known AesKey common to the system), then saved. And when used, they will be read, decrypted and then cached (in cache they can be plaintext).

At the end of this PBI also a small upgrade document must be created that details how to encrypt a certain setting item - this is needed because some setting values right now are in IaC and they will need to be moved to the database - through a manual or automatic process of the platform team (ideally, automatic, but their call). So either point to a website that knows how to encrypt a text based on an AesKey (they do have access to the key, as it is already defined in IaC and will be reused) or create a small CLI tool that using the utils implementation can encrypt a text and can be used programatically.

cases.title: CA-12533 - Automatically delete old deny list delta files (configurable)
cases.custom_steps:
We recently had an interesting issue on production (Lothian) that has amounted in S3 a number of 18000+ delta diff files, that added up to 20+ GB.

 

The deny list update job (for v2) goes through all the delta files available in S3 when it runs and tries to merge them with the latest delta changes, such that if a device is left over with its updates at any delta X, then when it requests an update gets all the changes up to the present.

This, obviously creates problems, on two levels:

on each run (the job is configured to run every 15 minutes), the service will download all the 20+GB of data (costs $$$) and try to update it
the update process takes a lot. On a local run (i7 + 32GB RAM + SSD) it took 4h to complete. On the AWS let's be optimistical and say it takes half of that, but this still means that the job runs tangle with eachother (and this also generates error, like a job trying to update an already updated delta).
 

In order to avoid this, we need (1) to create a new hangfire job (with it's respective deny list service protected endpoint - with the same roles as the write) that runs every day (once per day) and clears out any delta files older than a number of days (configurable - the agreed default configuration is 7 days / 1 week).

(2) Another thing to be tackled here is that the update process has a rule - if the size of a delta times a DiffScale (0.8) is greater than the full list size, then the delta gets deleted. And it seems that some of them do not get deleted, since we found some examples with deltaSize = 3.1MB, full list size 2.6MB, and the delta still being there.

In order to test this, one can generate random files (at least for the delete process) with similar names with the delta files (aka unix timestamps). Or use the connection to the ops3 environment where a prod version is exported and use some 'real files' from there (exported locally).

(3) Another thing that should be 'fixed' in the deny list service is to put the `foreach` that updates each delta files into a try-catch that logs an error, such as if one delta fails, not all the delta update process fails. Because if the process stops, no new deltas are created. This was observed as well in prod, since due to the processes running in parallel, when one job failed to update a delta, it failed and stopped.

 

Additional notes:

Deny list backup URL: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/denylist-ops3-uk-abt (lothian-prod)
User/pass: received from platform team.

On 31.12.22 there was an approved pre-auth for £1 with auth code = GPDPZB and trace ID = MDHJYGMDN1231
On 01.01.23 there was another approved pre-auth for £1 with auth code = BSMQ5Z and trace ID = MDHG8FFNY0101
On 02.01.23 we received those two presentments I mentioned above for £3.50 each, both sharing the same trace ID and the same auth code of the second pre-auth
We never received a presentment for auth code = GPDPZB or trace ID = MDHJYGMDN1231
We need to ensure that if multiple files are available then the valid Auth for that file is used during settlement.

cases.title: CA-12884 - Card Authorization is reoccurring for OP taps on a single day, if retail taps are in between.
cases.custom_steps:
Steps to Replicate:

Master/Visa card makes an OP tap
one initial AUTH entry should be in EMVCardAuthorisationResponse table.
Using same card makes a RETAIL tap
settlement entry should be in EMVCardAuthorisationResponse table.
Using same card now make an OP tap again.
This time another AUTH entry available in EMVCardAuthorisationResponse table.
Actual: As per the above steps , while we are doing the third tap with same card . its doing an AUTH again and its keep repeating if any retail taps in between each OP tap.

Expected: For OP taps initial AUTH should happen only once per business day.

 

Technical Details:

Below method needs be corrected in open payment service (EMVCardAuthorisationRequestRepository.cs file) to fetch all the records for today's date.

public EMVCardAuthorisationRequest GetWithResponses(long operatorId, string mediaId)
        {
            return (from req in dbContext.Set<EMVCardAuthorisationRequest>()
                    join res in dbContext.Set<EMVCardAuthorisationResponse>() on req.EMVCardAuthorisationRequestID equals res.EMVCardAuthorisationRequestID
                    where req.OperatorID == operatorId
                          && req.MediaID == mediaId
                    orderby req.EMVCardAuthorisationRequestID descending
                    select req)
                    .Include(x => x.EMVCardAuthorisationResponses)
                    .FirstOrDefault();
        } 
Then modify the below LINQ statement to just filter with is expired and EMVRequestType

EMVCardAuthorisationResponse response = auth.EMVCardAuthorisationResponses
                .OrderByDescending(resp => resp.Timestamp)
                .FirstOrDefault(resp => resp.EMVRequestType == DataModels.EMVRequestTypeEnum.Authorisation && resp.IsExpired == false)

cases.title: CA-13010 - Deny List - Parallelize deny list delta update process to improve performance
cases.custom_steps:
At the moment, when the deny list job is fired (from Hangfire), the update process begins, which does the following:

Update the full list with the current blocked tokens
Go through all the available deltas and update them (by merging current changes with their changes), such as any device from any timepoint can request an update and get all the correct changes up until the present
This process now is done sequentially (each delta is updated after the previous delta update finishes). But each delta is an individual file, and a delta update is independent of any other delta update. Therefore, all the updates can be parallelized, using multi-threading.

The process should still end when all updates finished successfully. If one thread throws error, the process should still continue.

This is not an urgent/mandatory update, but it will drastically improve the performance (time-wise) of the update process.

cases.title: CA-13341 - CLONE - Late taps with £0 charged to customer not being sent to MERIT
cases.custom_steps:
Currently in Translink they require a customer to tap twice to reach the daily cap (i.e. two £2.10 taps used to cap at £3.50).

If a customer taps 3 times in the same day but one of the taps is received late (i.e. after settlement for that day) then a record is not currently being sent to MERIT but it should be.

The record should be generated with a £0.00 fare and £2.10 full fare equivalent (as per the example above).

The lack of this information in MERIT affects Translink's passenger count reporting.

cases.title: CA-14069 - Fix query so that it can process production levels of data
cases.custom_steps:
A recent PBI NTOUL-297 made some changes to a query which has caused the system to be excessively slow when it is processing any sizable amount of data. 




There are the things that need to be fixed related to the Customer Info data query:

1) The Last Tap Date on the Customer Screen is configurable, therefore the JOIN that gets that data should be done only when the field is visible on screen

2) The JOIN with the TAP table is really slow and needs the following improvements:

     (a) The join should not be done when using GetCount. It's relevant only for column display, so remove.

     (b) The join should not use both MediaID and CardToken. Only MediaID.

     (c) Given the fact that this is paginated data, the full table join might actually perform better if it's deleted and transformed into a Select t.Details.JourneyDateTime From Tap Where MediaID IN (list of media ids), which would be a simple & fast Post-Query. This must be tested.

     (d) Make sure there is an index on MediaID used in JOIN

(3) The Group By Clause seems highly irellevant. Enable SQL logs to see how the final query is transformed, but the group by is on all the columns and should be removed.

cases.title: CA-13347 - OW portal enhancements relating to Retail (model 1) purchases.
cases.custom_steps:

1) ...be able to view only model 2 (OP) journeys, only model 1 (retail) or both model 1 & 2 journeys on the journey History screen in the OW. For this there will be two checkboxes: one for retail and one for OP. 

2) ...identify retail purchases by seeing a ticket icon beside the aggregated fare amount/payment successful symbol.

3) ...further identify retail purchases by the 'From' column containing the boarding stage name and the 'To' column containing the text "Ticket Purchase".

Reuse the EnableRetailTransactions to decide if to display the two checkboxes or not (display only if it's enabled). Add the 2 checkboxes in / above the table header (appearance to be agreed). By default, if enabled, both should be displayed (seems like the default state)
The back-end (Reporting service) is already done in the PW linked PBI
Update UI (PW): send the type flag, add icon as in excel (reuse from Flowbird Platform - DSM or from an icon library if not found here), add text for the Retail transactions (UI still, translatable) - seems weird but the static text is displayed only when both checkboxes are checked

Given John makes the following journeys

Start zone	End zone	Time	Fare	Service	ExcludeCapping	Type
A	A	today now	48.05	1	true	retail
And We wait until the retail settlement is complete for John
And Matthew makes the following journeys

Start zone	End zone	Time	Fare	Service	ExcludeCapping	Type
A	A	today now	48.05	1	true	retail
And We wait until the retail settlement is complete for Matthew
And Luke makes the following journeys

Start zone	End zone	Time	Fare	Service	ExcludeCapping	Type
A	A	today now	48.05	1	true	retail
And We wait until the retail settlement is complete for Luke
And I am logged in as Operator
And I go to Reports

cases.title: CA-13891 - Update communication with NMI Gateway to use enhanced messaging and prevent communication loss and uncommited transactions
cases.custom_steps:
Background // Problem

Currently, in case a transaction issued from ABT through the Payment Gateway to NMI is failed due to a communication issue (e.g. timeout most of the times, when the bank responds slow), then the transaction remains uncommited in WebMis, and is then retried in ABT, resulting in multiple transactions, one successful, the rest uncommited.

 

Solution

The solution for this is to use NMI's Enhanced Gateway Connection Messaging Pattern, which is designed specifically to deal with such situations. See Section 7 from NMI Direct Connect Integration guide attached to the page.

 

Technical details on the implementation

For this to work we need to ensure we're using inside Payment Gateway Service the latest CardEaseXML version (attached as zip).

Fortunately for us, we do not need to do all the steps from section 7 manually, since they are already implemented (more or less) in an semi-automatic manner inside the DLL, we just need to configure and react to it. A lecture of the steps from the documentation is mandatory for the following lines to make sense.

 

Step 0 - configuration

The Client needs to be configured, before doing a request, to enable reliability mode. To do this set (after initializing the instance, before doing any request):



client.SetConfigOption("reliabilitymode", 1);
Also we need to configure the default timeout (set in appsettings.json) as the maximum operation timeout used by NMI as well - 45 seconds.

 

Step 1 - Getting operation token

This consists of doing a HTTP HEAD operation to /operation.cex endpoint (not /generic.cex) with the Terminal ID and getting back an Operation ID.

This is done automatically by the library (ref ProcessXmlRequestDotNetFramework)

If this step fails, it means no actual communication with NMI has happened (the exception will not have any Operation ID). The whole process will need to be restarted by our end.

 

Step 2 - Performing the actual action

This consists of sending the actual request with a HTTP POST, by also attaching the operation headers obtained at steep 1.

This is done automatically by the library (ref ProcessXmlRequestDotNetFramework).

There is a step 2c in which we need to poll for a request if the response is not received, but the polling has a maximum lifetime of 45 seconds, which is the maximum timeout that we wait for a response as well. The request is automatically voided if it cannot be solved in this timeout. So no need to poll it. And no need to perform any voiding, as it's voided automatically inside the operation transaction (see table at the end)

 

Step 3 

confirming the operation

The process behaves like a transaction that, if successful, needs to be confirmed at the end. This is done with a HTTP POST to /operation.cex. 

This is done automatically by the library (ref ProcessXmlRequestDotNetFramework).

If this operation fails, it will still have a response attached (therefore a transaction reference and all the other details), that have just not been confirmed yet. An exception will be thrown with the appropriate action (which will most likely be void) which must be done manually by us (before eventually doing any other retries) (this is valid only for certain operations, see table below).

 

General step - reacting to CommunicationException

When calling ProcessRequest, the library will eventually raise a CardEaseXMLCommunicationException if something goes bad. As seen above, usually for step 1 and 2 there is not really anything to react to in most cases. But if a confirmation goes bad, usually we must do a void. 

A table with the possible states can be found below. The Recovery action is calculated and returned as an enum in the exception automatically. We must just implement a generic catch for this exception inside payment gateway and react accordingly
![](index.php?/attachments/get/190667)
None means we do nothing inside the payment gateway, but we can retry the whole process e.g. from Open Payment, it doesn't mean the transaction has finished successfully - it finishes successfully only when there is no exception happening (e.g. for authorizations).

Retry means we need to call again the ProcessRequest. This can be also encapsulated as an outside retry (e.g. if retry is implemented in OPS)

Void means that we need to immediately request a void with the transaction reference (which is available because it happens in step 3).

 

Note: this cannot be mocked. Needs to be tested against NMI.

 

NMI call ref: 549640
TL issue ref: L724

cases.title: CA-14006 - Update Shared Liability Method
cases.custom_steps:
Currently, the Shared Liability test uses the Issuer Country code tag 5F28 to determine the country and whether SLL should be applied. This tag is not used by Visa and as such a number of Visa cards do not go for SLL. Additionally, the Mastercard rules require checking of an additional tag. The following should be implemented

Mastercard
Check that both the Issuer Country Code (5F28) and Application Currency Code (9F42) both have a value of 0826 (UK) to allow Shared Liability

Visa
Check the Application Program Identifier (9F5A) and the numeric country code programmed within this. This country code to replace the check for 5F28 as it currently works.

Tag 9F5A consists of 5-16 bytes with bytes 4-5 being the country code. See extract from Visa document.

This change will require a check on the card brand first to then read the relevant tags.

Note: for backward compatibility, do we use 5F28 for Visa if tag 9F5A is not present?

Technical Notes:

In the current system card brand and country code pulled from 9F06 and 5F28 respectively while parsing the TLV data in tap data. This parsing is happening in two services of ABT  : Journey Tap (Identity Tap Manager ) and Open Payment (Declined JounreyTapProcessor), both the services using card brand and country code then deriving EMVCardtypeteritoryID from SCS table(EMVCardtypeteritorytype) to apply shared liability.

So, to implement the updates in deriving the country code using card brand needs to be implemented before deriving the EMVCardtypeteritoryID. This requires updates in abtutils during parsing and sanitizing the TLV data. 

Updates in ABT utils:

Pull 9F42 and 9F5A tag values to the TLV model while parsing the TLVdata
Pull the 4-5 bytes information from the 9F5A tag value during sanitizing TLV data as similar as pulling RID tag info for first 10 digits.
Implement new functionality to map the country code after above two steps (This requires SCS card types table information to identify the card brand for the RID fetched in TLV data).
Update ABT util version across all services of ABT. 
Master Card :
Check 5F28 if its null validate 9F42 tag value and map the country code from it. If both tags are empty then map this as NON UK as per existing logic.
Both tags 5F28 and 9F42 must have a value of 0826 to be acceptable for Shared Liability. If either of these is non UK or null then the card should not be marked as UK.
Visa Card :
Check 9F5A tag value and map the 4-5 bytes as country code , if its not present map the 5F28 value . If both tags are empty then map this as NON UK as per existing logic.

cases.title: CA-14069 - Fix query so that it can process production levels of data
cases.custom_steps:
A recent PBI NTOUL-297 made some changes to a query which has caused the system to be excessively slow when it is processing any sizable amount of data. 

 

There are the things that need to be fixed related to the Customer Info data query:

1) The Last Tap Date on the Customer Screen is configurable, therefore the JOIN that gets that data should be done only when the field is visible on screen

2) The JOIN with the TAP table is really slow and needs the following improvements:

     (a) The join should not be done when using GetCount. It's relevant only for column display, so remove.

     (b) The join should not use both MediaID and CardToken. Only MediaID.

     (c) Given the fact that this is paginated data, the full table join might actually perform better if it's deleted and transformed into a Select t.Details.JourneyDateTime From Tap Where MediaID IN (list of media ids), which would be a simple & fast Post-Query. This must be tested.

     (d) Make sure there is an index on MediaID used in JOIN

(3) The Group By Clause seems highly irellevant. Enable SQL logs to see how the final query is transformed, but the group by is on all the columns and should be removed.

cases.title: CA-14244 - Update 1st tap flow to handle retail tx correctly
cases.custom_steps:
During the first tap authorisation process (see diagram here), a pre-authorisation is done when the card is first received in the system, in order to find out it's card hash / reference / PAN, and save it into the Media Manager.

For retail transactions this process is not according to schema rules (retail must do only one authorization, with autoconfirm set to true, according to the PBI linked).

If a retail tx is the very first time a card has been seen then no pre-auth should be performed and instead the result of the retail tx should be used to populate the card reference and media.

This is likely causing a higher level of declines, specifically for Mastercard (as Visa performs an Account Verification Check and not a Pre-Auth).

 

Technical notes (extra)

We will need to pass the tap type flag from JTS to Account, where tap identification happens. Here, if the tap is retail, we must stop doing an extra authorisation.

Then, in OPS, when a retail settlement happens, we must make sure that, if we receive valid media details, we update them in MM, same as the op authorisations do.

 

Acceptance Criteria (migrated)


Given I have made a first card OP tap 
When I process the first card tap
Then I perform a pre-auth with NMI for the nominal amount
And use the response to populate the media data

Given I have made a first card Retail tap
When I process the card tap
Then I use the response from the retail tx with NMI to populate the media data

cases.title: TODEV-1881 - PW - Enhance date selection on transaction and journey History pages to allow up to 13 months.
cases.custom_steps:
As a customer I want to be able to choose a date range up to thirteen months in the past on the Journey  and Transaction history screens so that I have visibility of more than just one month of data. They want to “have a ‘from’ and ‘to’ date select function based on agreed 13 months timeframes for both journey and transaction tabs (format to be DD/MM/YYYY)”

 

Acceptance Criteria
Given I am viewing the journey or transaction history screen

When I enter a date up to thirteen months in the past

Then the screen will display journey or transaction data from the entered date until the latest data available

 

Technical Notes
Everything needs to be configurable. The implementation for having the journey filter show up to 13 months (or more) in the past and becoming a calendar selector can be enabled by specifying the 2 settings - JourneysFilterType and TransactionsFilterType (set them to Date). Changing this, based on the current implementation, reflects both in PW and OW. 

The number of days of data displayed is already changeable through the following settings:

CustomerJourneyHistoryMonths - number of months for OW

RegisteredUserJourneyHistoryMonths - number of months for PW (this must be 13, should already be)

AnonymousUserJourneyHistoryDays - number of days for anonymous, in PW (this shall not change)

AnonymousUserTransactionHistoryDays - number of days for anonymous, in PW (this shall not change)

RegisteredUserTransactionHistoryMonths - number of months for PW (this must be 13, should already be)

Transaction History on OW doesn’t have any limits

So they must be validated in IaC defaults setup for Translink (only).

We must also check the indexes that are used for filtering, on both JH and TH. Mainly if we have indexes on the Date columns used to filter and on the columns that are used to join various tables. A good opportunity to improve on those. Theoretically they should be fine because even if previously OW was showing 1 month of data only, it was still paginating data, so the return is the same and the difference negligible. 

We should test by generating some millions records in these 2 tables and then filtering.

QA shall be mainly visual with eventual test updates if we use the UI for tests (as the UI will change from a dropdown to a date selector).

Some documentation on generating data: parkeon-ondemand / businessservice_abt_mediamanager / ManualMigrationScripts / 1.2.180 — Bitbucket
